command:
cat >> /repo/pytest.ini << 'EOF'

norecursedirs =
    third_party
    build
    dist
    .git
    .github
    docs
    benchmarks
    cmake
    android
    scripts
    tools
    binaries
    .spin
    .vscode
    c10
    aten
    caffe2
    torchgen
    functorch
    mypy_plugins
EOF

echo '[pytest] addopts =     # show summary of all tests that did not pass     -rEfX     # Make tracebacks shorter     --tb=native     # capture only Python print and C++ py::print, but not C output (low-level Python errors)     --capture=sys     # don'\''t suppress warnings, but don'\''t shove them all to the end either     -p no:warnings     # Use custom pytest shard located in test/pytest_shard_custom.py instead     -p no:pytest-shard     # don'\''t rewrite assertions (usually not a problem in CI due to differences in imports, see #95844)     --assert=plain testpaths =     test junit_logging_reruns = all filterwarnings =     ignore:Module already imported so cannot be rewritten.*hypothesis:pytest.PytestAssertRewriteWarning xfail_strict = True markers =     serial: marks tests as needs to be run serially (deselect with '\''-m \"not serial\"'\'') norecursedirs =     third_party     build     dist     .git     .github     docs     benchmarks     cmake     android     scripts     tools     binaries     .spin     .vscode     c10     aten     caffe2     torchgen     functorch     mypy_plugins' > /repo/pytest.ini

python3 -c " import configparser, io # Read the existing pytest.ini with open('/repo/pytest.ini', 'r') as f:     content = f.read()  # Parse with configparser to handle the ini format # But pytest.ini uses a special format, let's just append norecursedirs lines = content.split('\n') # Find the end of the [pytest] section and add norecursedirs new_lines = [] in_pytest = False added = False for line in lines:     new_lines.append(line)     if line.strip() == '[pytest]':         in_pytest = True     elif in_pytest and line.strip().startswith('[') and line.strip() != '[pytest]':         in_pytest = False     elif in_pytest and not added and line.strip().startswith('markers'):         # Add after markers         new_lines.append('norecursedirs =')         new_lines.append('    third_party')         new_lines.append('    build')         new_lines.append('    dist')         new_lines.append('    .git')         new_lines.append('    .github')         new_lines.append('    docs')         new_lines.append('    benchmarks')         new_lines.append('    cmake')         new_lines.append('    android')         new_lines.append('    scripts')         new_lines.append('    tools')         new_lines.append('    binaries')         new_lines.append('    .spin')         new_lines.append('    .vscode')         new_lines.append('    c10')         new_lines.append('    aten')         new_lines.append('    caffe2')         new_lines.append('    torchgen')         new_lines.append('    functorch')         new_lines.append('    mypy_plugins')         added = True  with open('/repo/pytest.ini', 'w') as f:     f.write('\n'.join(new_lines)) print('Done') "

python3 -c " with open('/repo/pytest.ini', 'r') as f:     content = f.read() # Add norecursedirs after the markers line old = 'xfail_strict = True' new = '''xfail_strict = True norecursedirs =     third_party     build     dist     .git     .github     docs     benchmarks     cmake     android     scripts     tools     binaries     .spin     .vscode     c10     aten     caffe2     torchgen     functorch     mypy_plugins''' content = content.replace(old, new) with open('/repo/pytest.ini', 'w') as f:     f.write(content) print('Done') "

cat > /tmp/fix_pytest.py << 'ENDOFPYTHON'
with open('/repo/pytest.ini', 'r') as f:
    content = f.read()
old = 'xfail_strict = True'
new = '''xfail_strict = True
norecursedirs =
    third_party
    build
    dist
    .git
    .github
    docs
    benchmarks
    cmake
    android
    scripts
    tools
    binaries
    .spin
    .vscode
    c10
    aten
    caffe2
    torchgen
    functorch
    mypy_plugins'''
content = content.replace(old, new)
with open('/repo/pytest.ini', 'w') as f:
    f.write(content)
print('Done')
ENDOFPYTHON python3 /tmp/fix_pytest.py

printf '
norecursedirs =
    third_party
    build

    .git

    cmake
    android
    scripts

    .spin
    .vscode

    mypy_plugins
' >> /repo/pytest.ini
